about: Sentences about owners, approvers, timings, volumes and systems that were written only after the rules of the uncertainty gate (interview_coverage.UNCERTAINTY_MASKS and UNCERTAINTY_RULES) were final, to measure the rules on wording they were not built from. Each row is [decision, topic, sentence]: 'hold' must be held at partial, 'pass' must stay captured. The first set was written against the rules of lane commit 563b7bf: 66 of its 72 sentences were decided correctly (31 of 36 held, 35 of 36 passed) and 'missed_when_written' lists the six that were not; the constructions behind them were then added. The second set was written against the rules of 1f0858f: all 64 were decided correctly. Two exemptions were corrected after that, when the whole suite was run ('not known by any other names' uses the word of a name, 'the owner may be changed' is a permission); neither changed a decision in either set. On the rules before this work (tag wave1) the first set had 11 wrong decisions and the second 3. tests/test_uncertainty_gate.py and tests/test_uncertainty_gate.cjs require every row to be decided as labelled; a sentence added here later is no longer held out.
